namn.title: Welcome! What do you look like?
namn.lead: Check the name and feel free to add your logo, so everyone recognises the association.

styrelsen.title: Who is on the board?
styrelsen.lead: One list for everyone: name and role for the notes, e-mail for anyone who should be able to start meetings.

mapp.title: Where should the meeting documents go?
mapp.lead: Simon Says writes each meeting in a Google Doc. Choose a folder in Drive that the board shares.

format.title: How you usually meet
format.lead: Simon Says writes the minutes in your format, a Weekly meeting to start with. Under Change you can switch format, let Simon Says learn from your old minutes or read the annual meeting's agenda from your statutes.

protokoll.title: Your earlier meetings
protokoll.lead: Import old minutes, so Simon Says knows what you've decided and what's going on – already for the first meeting.

roster.title: Voices (optional)
roster.lead: Simon Says can learn who's speaking, so you don't need the name round every time.

klart.title: You're ready
klart.lead: Now you can prepare the first meeting. Anything you skipped can be done at any time.

card.title: Get started
card.text: Logo, the board, meeting folder, how you usually meet, your old minutes and voices. Everything is optional and takes a few minutes.

shell.label: Get started
shell.doneNote: Done. You can change this at any time under <link>Settings → {section}</link>.
shell.importNote: Read in more minutes at any time under <link>Earlier minutes</link>.

board.emptyText: Start with yourself. The names help Simon Says recognise who is speaking, and the roles end up in the minutes: “Treasurer: book a room”. An e-mail address is only needed for anyone who should be able to start meetings and get the documents.
board.inviteText: Simon Says sends an e-mail with the association's link to the addresses. Whoever signs in with the address you typed is linked to their name here.
board.shareText: Share the link, e.g. in the board's chat. Whoever opens it and signs in with Google becomes a member; with an address from the list they are linked to their name.
board.nameOnly: Name only – add an e-mail address if they should be able to start meetings
board.nameRequired: Type a name, e.g. Anna Berg.
board.name: Name

folder.chosen: Chosen – new meeting documents go here
folder.pick: Choose a folder in Google Drive
folder.noneText: Choose the folder where you already keep your minutes, or create a new one in Drive first (e.g. “Board 2026–2027”). Share it with the board, so everyone can reach the documents.
folder.pickerOff: The Google picker isn't set up yet. Without a meeting folder, the documents go in the Drive of whoever starts the meeting.

format.keepHint: The format you have already chosen.
format.weeklyHint: The usual meeting: {items}. Tasks are followed up next time. (Meeting documents are written in Swedish.)
format.learnHint: Simon Says reads the structure of a couple of old minutes (only the headings and the order) and writes the same way.

history.pickText: Select your old minutes in Google Drive – ideally a whole year of activity.
history.costText: Before anything is read, you see how many meetings it is and what it costs.
history.orderText: Decisions, tasks and what you've worked on end up in Overview, and become proposed goals.
history.soFar: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}} imported so far.
history.hint: Opens Overview. Come back here with “Get started” on the association page.

voices.soon: Soon: Simon Says learns the voices from the name round in your first meeting — nobody needs to record anything.
voices.idea: The idea: everyone says their name in the name round, as usual, and that sentence becomes the voice Simon Says recognises – once, never again. Then the names are there right from the second meeting.
voices.notYet: It doesn't work yet: the feature is being tested and will be switched on later. Until then no voice is stored, and the name round works as it does today. A voice is sensitive information: when the feature comes, it's only stored for those who have said yes, can be removed at any time and is removed when someone leaves the association (then your yes is removed too).
voices.noBoardText: Add the board first, then you can tick who has said yes.
voices.legend: Who has said yes to Simon Says learning their voice?
voices.saidYes: Has said yes. They'll be asked again before anything is stored.
voices.askEach: Ask each person. Only tick those who have said yes themselves.
